title: Remapping ALT + NumPad # breaks KBM when using Right ALT

status.label: Confirm current AltGr behavior
status.detail: The report is precise but dates from v0.79.0; current-version and layout confirmation are needed.

judgment.rationale: The report provides a specific Left Alt versus Right Alt comparison for an app-specific Alt+NumPad-to-text mapping and describes a persistent shortcut-state failure until restart. Current Keyboard Manager code has an AltGr-specific state path, but the supplied reproduction is old and the keyboard layout is unknown; current behavior and the exact AltGr key representation must be confirmed before treating this as an active defect.
evidence: The reporter lists PowerToys 0.79.0 and says Left Alt plus NumPad produces the configured text.
The same mapping with Right Alt causes Right Ctrl to behave like Alt and other Keyboard Manager shortcuts to stop working until PowerToys is restarted.
The issue has no comments, attachments, assignee, or recorded outstanding request for author evidence.

Current-main KeyboardEventHandlers.cpp tracks Right Alt when paired with Left Ctrl and preserves AltGr state during shortcut release; current tests cover AltGr state handling but not this exact app-specific Alt+NumPad-to-text sequence.
judgment.recommended_action: Confirm whether the exact sequence still reproduces on current stable PowerToys and identify the keyboard layout and how the trigger is represented before designing a state-management change.

fix_assessment.rationale: If still present, the failure is consistent with the AltGr-generated Left Ctrl component being released or retained incorrectly as an app-specific text shortcut completes. Current source already contains AltGr handling, so the exact reported sequence must be retested before changing that logic.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep AltGr state balanced for app-specific text remaps
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The Right Alt/AltGr trigger may leave the synthetic Left Ctrl component in the wrong state when the Alt+NumPad text remap completes, which would explain why unrelated Keyboard Manager shortcuts remain unusable until restart. Whether this exact text-remap path is still affected is unconfirmed.
plan: Reproduce the reported app-specific Alt+NumPad-to-text mapping on a current stable build using a layout that exposes Right Alt as AltGr.
Trace the Right Alt and synthetic Left Ctrl down/up sequence through shortcut completion and verify the engine's state is balanced afterward.
If the state is still corrupted, correct the AltGr-specific release/reset handling for text targets and add a regression test matching the reported sequence.
Verify that subsequent unrelated remappings work without restarting PowerToys.
verification: With the same layout and mapping, confirm Left Alt and Right Alt behavior separately.
After the Right Alt text mapping fires, invoke a second unrelated Keyboard Manager remap and confirm it still works.
Run the focused AltGr shortcut-remapping regression tests.

confidence.rationale: The reported symptom fits AltGr modifier-state corruption and current code has an AltGr-specific path, but the report predates that path and gives no keyboard layout or current-release result.

issue_context.summary: An app-specific Alt+NumPad text remap works with Left Alt, but Right Alt causes a persistent Keyboard Manager modifier/shortcut failure until restart.
known_information: The issue reports PowerToys 0.79.0, installed by auto-update and running as administrator.
The reporter says Left Alt plus NumPad produces the configured text for a specific executable.
Using Right Alt produces a Right Ctrl/Alt state problem and prevents other Keyboard Manager shortcuts until restart.
No keyboard layout, current-version test, comments, attachment, or assignee is recorded.
inferences: Right Alt may be acting as AltGr, which Windows can represent with a Left Ctrl component; the issue does not identify the active layout.
The failure may be in modifier-state cleanup for the text-remap path, but existing AltGr handling in current main means the 2024 report may already have changed behavior.
issue_context.analysis: The Left-versus-Right Alt contrast and restart workaround point to modifier-state corruption rather than the text payload itself. The current source already contains AltGr-specific shortcut handling, but existing regression coverage does not match this exact app-specific Alt+NumPad-to-text sequence. A current-release check and layout description are the smallest evidence needed before changing that code.

Reviewed current-main AltGr regression coverage; it tests AltGr state with another shortcut but not an app-specific Alt+NumPad text mapping.
Checked current assignment and issue status; the issue is open, unassigned, and has no real outstanding author request.

comment.body:
Thanks for the precise Left Alt versus Right Alt steps and for noting that the other Keyboard Manager shortcuts stay broken until restart. Current Keyboard Manager code has an AltGr-specific state path, but the report is from v0.79.0 and the exact keyboard layout is not recorded.

Please confirm:
1. Does the same app-specific Alt+NumPad-to-text mapping still fail on current stable PowerToys (v0.102.3001 or later)? If it does, does PowerToys still need to be restarted afterward?
2. What Windows keyboard language/layout are you using, and does Keyboard Manager display the trigger as Right Alt or AltGr?

This will tell us whether the old behavior remains and whether AltGr-specific modifier handling is implicated. No additional upload is necessary for this check.
